purpose: Opaque base-color map of the existing central rug for the approved A-hearth-study target; source asset only.

reference.role: User-selected rug material and border reference only; exclude lighting, perspective, table and fringe

existing_texture_inspected.role: Inspected prior rug atlas; not passed to ImageGen and not modified

source.actual_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: opaque PBR base-color/albedo image for the top surface of an existing real 3D woven rug.
Input image 1: the explicitly selected A-hearth-study scene. MATERIAL AND RUG-DESIGN REFERENCE ONLY. Focus on the dark modest woven rug under the central round table. Reconstruct that rug from directly overhead with the table removed. Do not transfer any scene perspective, furniture, lighting, shadow, floor, glow or fringe.
Primary request: one complete near-square rectangular woven rug surface, proportions 3.8 metres wide by 3.5 metres tall, width only slightly greater than height, approximately 1520 x 1400 pixels or higher. The rug body itself fills the entire rectangular image edge to edge; no background or margin outside the textile.
Design: fine dense handwoven fabric in subdued deep smoky cocoa brown / flax-linen brown, with small natural fibers and softly irregular interlaced threads. The central field is plain and evenly woven, understated and nearly uniform, without motifs or ornaments. Match the approved A image's quiet, tactile material and detail density. Dark warm brown with slight grey-earth undertone, not red/burgundy, not orange, not black. A low-contrast double narrow woven rectangular border runs continuously around all four sides, complete at every corner. Two slender understated taupe-brown woven binding bands, a little lighter than the field, separated by a small strip of the same dark fabric. Keep both border bands narrow and fully inside the rug body; the outer band starts just a few percent inside the image edge, inner band around seven percent inset. The border is made of natural threads, never metallic or gold.
Composition: perfectly front-on/orthographic overhead UV texture, no thickness, no bevel perspective, no foreshortening. Full complete rug body with all four border corners visible and no cropped border.
Albedo: uniform neutral diffuse illumination, intrinsic pigment only, consistent average tone from center to edges, no brighter center, no vignette. The fabric should carry subtle fiber color differences but not baked self-shadow, cast shadows, or shiny thread highlights.
Constraints: NO external tassels, fringe or loose strands beyond the rug body (fringe already exists as 3D geometry). No room, table, furniture, wooden floor, floorboards, objects, occlusion, perspective, cast light, shadow, glowing details, text, symbols, floral patterns, medallions, heraldic or ornate motifs, watermark, extra framing or outer background. Output only the usable opaque textile base-color image.

output.uv_layout: Whole image maps once across the complete top face; width maps to the 3.8 m axis. No atlas subrectangle.

validation.visible_subject: Uniform front-on dark smoky/linen-brown fine woven fabric. Plain center and two narrow complete low-contrast taupe-brown border bands. Every corner visible. No floor/background, external fringe, furniture, text, glow or cast shadows.
limitations: Requested approximately 1520 by 1400 pixels; actual output dimensions are recorded above without resampling.
This is an albedo texture, not a roughness or normal map. Fine fiber color variation is present; actual depth and lighting belong to the 3D material.
No browser, UV, in-scene color/lighting or geometry verification was performed by this asset task.
